run_f_gold_extract_first_letters: run f_gold to extract the first letter of every word from a space-separated string
test_f_gold_with_single_word: test f_gold with a single word input and verify it returns that word's first letter
test_f_gold_with_numeric_string: test f_gold with a numeric space-separated string and verify it returns the first digit of each number
test_f_gold_with_mixed_case_string: test f_gold with a mixed-case space-separated string and verify it preserves case of first letters
test_f_gold_with_empty_spaces: test f_gold with a string containing multiple spaces between words and verify correct first-letter extraction
